mandatoryFindings.problem: retained_source_read checks str(path) in the canonical external_inputs registry before normalizing. A supported raw string alias containing /./ misses that test, then generic System.read normalizes Path(path) and opens the same registered leaf with mode=None and without registered raw SHA verification or retained-buffer continuity. mandatoryFindings.supportedInputAdjudication: No type/canonical-Path-only precondition is enforced by the new callback. The historical anchored_raw explicitly coerced Path(path), generic System.read accepts str and normalizes, and direct d.sha calls SAFE_READER without its own canonical guard. Usual internal Path callers do not establish an invariant excluding supported str input.
mandatoryFindings.impact: The exact all-consumer mode/hash-before-body promise fails for a registered alias. This is a source-level bypass under supported reader input, not evidence of a current actual exploit, original private-file access or the immediate historical failed member.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: In a new immutable exact correction, normalize to the approved System path representation before membership dispatch, or explicitly reject noncanonical aliases before any body/metadata access. Use that same validated canonical identity for registry lookup and both downstream routes, preserving existing unregistered package/binary/prior/qualified-baseline policies/caps. Every registered alias must either use declared expectedmode/hash via bound or HOLD before body. Preserve original600 privacy, no source/caller modes/None/default escape, complete-first actors and all inherited invariants; exact affected independent review/root adoption remains required.
